Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:194632
Court No. - 66

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 43960 of 2024
Applicant :- Maya Devi

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohd. Samiuzzaman Khan,Zeeshan Khan

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Satyam Pandey,Shivam Pandey Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1. Heard Sri Mohd. Samiuzzaman Khan and Sri Zeeshan Khan, learned counsels for the applicant;
Sri Satyam Pandey, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Ghanshyam Mishra, learned brief holder for the State-respondent.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
193 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 304B IPC and 3/4 DP Act, Police Station Maharajpur,
District Kanpur Nagar, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

3. Learned counsels for the applicant submitted that applicant is mother in law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused in the present case alongwith other family members including her son i.e. husband of the deceased.
4. They further submitted that however, deceased died within one year of her marriage due to hanging but being mother in law of the deceased , applicant cannot be held liable for her death.

They further submitted that it appears deceased was having pregnancy of 7 months and some dispute Maya Devi vs State Of U.P. on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179565580/
1 arose between husband and wife and thereafter wife i.e. deceased in anger hanged herself.

entities.text: Maya Devi vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. They further submitted that post mortem report of the deceased also suggests that she died due to hanging.
6. They further submitted that applicant is old and infirm person and there is no specific allegation against her.
7. They further submitted that even from the FIR it reflects that husband of the deceased after the incident himself informed the informant and this shows bonafide on the part of the applicant side.

8. They further submitted that bail application of father in law of the deceased has already been allowed by this Court vide order date 10.12.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.
44006 of 2024 and on facts, case of applicant is at par with him.
9.

entities.text:
Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.
44006 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: They further submitted that applicant is lady and she is in jail in the present matter since 17.10.2024.

10. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is mother in law of the deceased and her daughter in law died within one year of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry and but could not dispute the fact that there is no specific allegation against the applicant and as per post mortem report deceased died due to hanging.
11.
They further could not dispute the fact that bail application of father in law of the deceased has already been allowed by this Court.
12. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

13. However, daughter in law of the applicant died within one year of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but applicant is mother in law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her.

14. Further, post mortem report of the applicant suggests that deceased died due to hanging,
therefore, prima facie, it appears to be a case of suicidal death.
15. Further, bail application of father in law of the deceased has already been allowed.
16. Further, applicant is lady and she is in jail in the present matter since October, 2024.
17. Further, law is settled that bail should not be withheld for punitive purposes and bail is rule while bail rejection is an exception.

sentences.text:
Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
19. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

20. Let the applicant-Maya Devi, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
21. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

22. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 11.12.2024
